headline_hint: Why Illumina (ILMN) stock is down today
instructions: The move is happening now. Use the latest quote; if the session has closed by the time you write, use the close and say so. The company reported results today or last night: make the results the cause, and link the recap if one exists.

facts.name: Illumina
sentences: Illumina's shares moved 5% or more on 21 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 28 October 2026, when the stock rose 3.3%.
The stock is up 121.2% this year, and at $290.06 it sits 1.2% below its 52-week closing high of $293.69 from 5 October 2026.
$1,000 invested in Illumina five years ago would be worth $712 today.
